description: p62's input with `x_undefined: 1` added to its last attestation. p62's first attestation is a string, which has no members to read; the entries after it are closed objects and are still checked, so the record rejects with unknown_member_reject. p62 is the accepting twin. An engine that stops checking at the first entry that is not an object accepts this vector. Rests on `defined_members` in MANIFEST.json.
